title: First Steps
brief:
Welcome to the platformer. Your character is bound by gravity — and can only move when your Python code tells them to.

  • right() — walk one tile to the right.
  • left() — walk one tile to the left.

Every call moves exactly one tile, so four calls move four tiles. Collect the flag to finish the level.

Write your code in the panel on the right, then press Run.
